ruleDefinitions.name: AWS SecurityHub Findings Evasion
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the modification of the findings on SecurityHub. Note: Unmapped fields: eventSource, eventName

sequences.query: (eventSource = "securityhub\.amazonaws\.com" AND (eventName = "BatchUpdateFindings" OR eventName = "DeleteInsight" OR eventName = "UpdateFindings" OR eventName = "UpdateInsight"))
